title: One Frame for Five Human Needs: The Quilting Bee
dek: Where else do people get the things they need at once, without being paid to be there? We listed forty places, developed the ten with the best evidence, and found one that holds all five needs and all four paradoxes: the quilting bee.
cover_alt: Frames drawn as rows across five coloured need lines. The top row, the quilting bee, has a filled station on all five lines, joined by one bar; below it, ten frames each join two.
